pre_validation_normalization.rule: Remove encrypted_nodes, nodes, markup and encrypted_metadata when their value is null.
Remove optional empty arrays and empty objects before canonical schema validation.
An empty string is not an absent ciphertext and must be rejected.

rules.rule: The sum of Unicode code points in all plaintext nodes must not exceed 4096.
Layout nesting depth must not exceed 10.
Every entity and layout node index must be less than the number of nodes or encrypted_nodes in the document.
Every secret_ref must be unique within a revision.
After decrypting encrypted_metadata, its non-empty object keys must match the document secret_ref set exactly; dangling and unused keys are rejected.
Every private media binding requires secret_ref and structural presence of encrypted_metadata.
Private text_link requires secret_ref and forbids href; public text_link requires href and forbids secret_ref.
Send or publish requires a non-empty text array or a recursive media binding with media_id.
metadata.content_mode must equal groups.kind; one-to-one messages require private mode.
When an enclosing revision_number field exists, it must equal metadata.revision_number.
Private envelope bitmap uses bit order encrypted_nodes, nodes, markup, encrypted_metadata; nodes bit is always zero.
Private envelope protocol_version and metadata.format_version are both fixed to 2.
After recovering a content key on every ratchet, wrapped or escrow path, recompute HKDF-SHA256(key, info=tima/commit/v1, L=32) and compare in constant time with key_commitment.
Reject scripts, macros, active HTML or SVG, event handlers, embedded executables, polyglots and javascript URLs after decoding and canonical URL inspection.
Byte strings use canonical padded base64; implementations must still perform strict decoding because contentEncoding can be annotation-only in validators.
